name: scene3d_patch_keyframes
description: Patch Motion camera keyframes by id. Setting cut:true requires cutFrom and local timestamp>0; unrelated patches preserve legacy cuts. @see guides_get('scene3d')

patches.description: Keyframe patches; each must carry an existing id.

patch.description: Partial keyframe fields; must contain at least one change.

cameraId.description: Saved camera id copied verbatim from scene3d_state cameras. Never synthesize a __camera_N__ placeholder; when no saved camera was returned, omit cameraId and patch position + target.

cut.description: True starts a hard cut; false removes cut and cutFrom.

cutFrom.description: Outgoing full camera snapshot. Required when setting cut:true.

focalDistance.description: Required with quaternion; forbidden with target.

quaternion.description: Outgoing orientation; requires focalDistance; alternative to target.

target.description: Outgoing look-at; derives focus, so omit focalDistance.

easing.description: Easing: smooth, linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out.

focalDistance.description: Focus plane distance in world units. Mutually exclusive with target; for a focus pull, send it without target.

focalLength.description: Lens mm (>= 1); recomputes fov unless fov is also set.

position.description: New {x,y,z} position in world units. Keep it outside object footprints and geometry from scene3d_state; never place a close-up camera inside the subject or set.

target.description: Look-at point in world units; re-aims and focuses from the effective keyframe position. Aim at actual subject geometry: a SOMA actor is about 0.8u tall, so its face is roughly base y + 0.65–0.75u, not a height in metres. Mutually exclusive with quaternion and focalDistance.
